questions.stem: 今年的最低工資比去年高出百分之五，迫使許多小店家調漲商品的價格。
questions.answer: This year's minimum wage is five percent higher than last year's, forcing many small shops to raise the prices of their products.
accepted_answers: The minimum wage this year is 5 percent higher than it was last year, forcing many small businesses to raise their prices.
This year, the minimum wage is 5% higher than that of last year, forcing many small stores to increase the prices of their goods.

questions.stem: 對這些店家的老闆來說，每個月付給員工更高的薪水，常被視為沉重的經濟負擔。
questions.answer: For the owners of these shops, paying their employees higher wages every month is often seen as a heavy financial burden.
accepted_answers: For these shop owners, paying higher salaries to their workers every month is often regarded as a heavy economic burden.
To the owners of these stores, paying their staff higher wages each month is often viewed as a great financial burden.

1.explanation_zh: 「比去年高出百分之五」用比較級：This year's minimum wage is five percent higher than last year's，數量 five percent 放在 higher 前面；比較的是兩年的最低工資，所以寫 last year's（＝last year's minimum wage）或 that of last year。「迫使許多小店家調漲…」是前面整件事的結果，用句尾分詞 forcing many small shops to raise …（force + 人 + to VR）。「調漲價格」是 raise prices，不要寫成不及物的 rise。
evidence: 迫使許多小店家調漲商品的價格
1.strategy_zh: 比較句先確認比較的兩樣東西是否對等（今年的工資 vs. 去年的工資）；句尾「迫使…」用逗號＋forcing。
hints: 切成四段：今年的最低工資／比去年高出百分之五／迫使許多小店家／調漲商品的價格
標的詞彙：minimum wage（最低工資）、year（年）、higher（較高的）、last year（去年）、force（迫使）、small shop（小店家）、raise（調漲）、price（價格）、product（商品）
句型框架：This year's + N + is five percent higher than last year's, forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「每個月付給員工更高的薪水」是一個動作，當主詞用動名詞 Paying their employees higher wages every month（或 paying higher wages to their employees），後面動詞用單數 is。「常被視為」用被動 is often seen／regarded as。「經濟負擔」是 financial／economic burden，economy 是名詞，不能直接修飾 burden。
evidence: 每個月付給員工更高的薪水
常被視為沉重的經濟負擔
2.strategy_zh: 「對…來說」先放句首；真正的主詞是一件事時用動名詞，再接 be seen as。
hints: 切成四段：對這些店家的老闆來說／每個月付給員工更高的薪水／常被視為／沉重的經濟負擔
標的詞彙：owner（老闆）、shop（店家）、pay（付）、employee（員工）、wage（薪水）、month（月）、regard（視為）、heavy（沉重的）、financial（經濟的）、burden（負擔）
句型框架：For + N, V-ing … + is often seen as + a heavy financial burden

traps.literal_error: This year's lowest salary is five percent higher than last year's, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「最低工資」是法定名詞 minimum wage；照字面寫 lowest salary 意思不對。

traps.literal_error: …, forcing many small shops rise the prices of their products.
traps.explanation_zh: force + 人 + to VR，「調漲」要用及物動詞 raise；寫成 rise（不及物）或漏掉 to 都會扣分。

bonus.text: With this year's minimum wage five percent higher than last year's, many small shops have had no choice but to raise their prices.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 with + 受詞 + 補語（附帶狀況）交代背景，再用 have no choice but to VR（不得不）強調「迫使」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「今年的最低工資比去年高出百分之五」比較的是兩年的最低工資，英文寫 than last year's（或 than that of last year），百分比 five percent 放在比較級 higher 前面；「迫使…」承接前面整件事，用句尾分詞 forcing … to VR，不另起一句。
1.notes_zh: 第 3 部分寫成非限定關係子句 , which forces／has forced many small shops to … 也表達同一個「前面整件事造成的結果」，算作 PART 的可接受寫法（已列入 accepted）。比較對象寫 than last year 雖不如 last year's 精確，屬常見寫法，一併接受。寫成 has risen by five percent from last year 沒有用到比較級，不在可接受寫法內；寫成 so many small shops have to … 是對等子句，也不在可接受寫法內。

traps.zh: 每個月付給員工更高的薪水
traps.literal_error: For the owners of these shops, pay their employees higher wages every month is often seen as a heavy financial burden.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用「付給員工更高的薪水」這件事當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Paying …，動詞用單數 is。

traps.literal_error: … is often seen as a heavy economy burden.
traps.explanation_zh: 「經濟負擔」是複合概念，英文用形容詞 financial／economic 修飾 burden；economy 是名詞。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文以「每個月付給員工更高的薪水」這件事當主題，英文用動名詞主詞 Paying their employees higher wages every month，動詞用單數 is；「常被視為」是 is often seen／regarded as；「對…來說」放句首寫成 For the owners of these shops,。
2.notes_zh: 第 2 部分寫成虛主詞句 it is often seen as a heavy financial burden to pay … 也算 NFSUBJ（不定詞主詞後移），第 3 部分這時是 is often seen as。寫成 These shop owners often regard paying … as … 是主動句，沒有用到被動，不在可接受寫法內。「經濟負擔」寫 financial burden 或 economic burden 都可以；「薪水」寫 wages、salaries、pay 都可以。

1.translation: This year's minimum wage is five percent higher than last year's, forcing many small shops to raise the prices of their goods.
1.explanation_zh: 「比去年高出百分之五」用 five percent higher than last year's（比較對象是去年的最低工資，所以用所有格）；「迫使」用分詞構句 forcing … to raise。

2.translation: For the owners of these shops, paying their employees higher wages every month is often regarded as a heavy financial burden.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語 paying … higher wages 當主詞；「常被視為」用 is often regarded as；「沉重的經濟負擔」譯 a heavy financial burden。

1.translation: This year's minimum wage is five percent higher than last year's, forcing many small shops to raise the prices of their goods.
1.explanation_zh: 「比去年高出百分之五」用 five percent higher than last year's（避免重複 minimum wage）；後半「迫使……調漲」用分詞構句 forcing ... to raise。

2.translation: For the owners of these shops, paying their employees higher salaries every month is often regarded as a heavy financial burden.
2.explanation_zh: 「對……老闆來說」用 For ...；「每個月付給員工更高的薪水」用動名詞片語當主詞；「被視為」be regarded as，「沉重的經濟負擔」a heavy financial burden。
